RatioValue.description:
A single computed ratio, or an explicit reason it couldn't be computed.

Micro-entity accounts frequently omit the line items a ratio needs (e.g.
no P&L filed at all), so every ratio in `RatioSet` is wrapped in this
rather than being a bare `float | None` — `computable=False` plus
`reason` is what lets the scoring module and the UI distinguish "this
company has a ratio of zero" from "we don't have enough data".

computable.description: Whether enough source data existed to compute this.
computable.title: Computable

reason.description: Set when computable=False, e.g. 'no P&L filed (micro-entity exemption)'.
reason.title: Reason

RatioValue.title: RatioValue

YoyTrend.description:
Year-over-year direction for one ratio, computed when 2+ filing years
are available.

delta_pct.description: % change year-over-year, null if not computable.
delta_pct.title: Delta Pct

metric.description: Which underlying figure this trend describes, e.g. 'net_assets'.
metric.title: Metric

YoyTrend.title: YoyTrend

description:
Financial ratios for a company, computed from its most recent (and
prior, for trends) FinancialExtracts.

`company_number` is here (not just on FinancialExtract) so that
`scoring.score()` can resolve mock/real data by company number from
this object alone — see `backend/app/workers/pipeline.py`.

filing_year.description: Most recent filing year these ratios are computed as-of.
filing_year.title: Filing Year

net_assets.description: Passthrough of balance_sheet.net_assets, flagged if negative.
